// a.ts — one import site per SHAPE and per SPECIFIER KIND.
//
// Stored as `.ts.txt` and materialised to a real tree at test time: the repo's
// tsconfig includes `test/**/*.ts`, and this file deliberately imports a
// missing module and a package subpath, both of which are tsc errors. The
// resolver oracle needs real files on disk, so the tree is written to a temp
// directory instead of living under test/ as .ts.

import def, { v1 } from './b.ts';          // default + named, value
import type { T1 } from './types.ts';      // DECLARATION-level type-only
import { type T2, v2 } from './b.ts';      // mixed: inline type + value
import { type T3 } from './types2.ts';     // INLINE type-only, and nothing else
import * as ns from './sub/c.ts';          // namespace, multi-segment relative
import './side.ts';                        // side effect: no binding at all
import fs from 'node:fs';                  // node builtin
import { parse } from '@babel/parser';     // bare
import sp from '#sub';                     // subpath import
import { gone } from './nope.ts';          // relative, and the file is not there

export const chosen = './dyn.ts';
export const m = import('./dyn.ts');       // dynamic, literal argument
export const n = import(chosen);           // dynamic, COMPUTED argument
export const use = [def, v1, v2, ns, fs, parse, sp, gone, m, n];
export type Alias = T1 | T2 | T3;
